Initial Diagnosis March 2018

Patient presented with progressive cervical and axillary lymphadenopathy,
fatigue, and intermittent night sweats.

Diagnostic Workup Excisional lymph node biopsy showed follicular lymphoma
grade 1–2 with CD20+, CD10+, BCL2+, and BCL6+ markers.

Bone marrow biopsy showed 20% marrow involvement.

PET/CT demonstrated diffuse nodal disease above and below the diaphragm
with splenic involvement.

document_terms.evidence: First Relapse June 2021 Patient developed enlarging inguinal lymph nodes, fatigue, and recurrent night sweats. PET/CT demonstrated hypermetabolic pelvic and retroperitoneal adenopathy. Biopsy confirmed recurrent follicular lymphoma grade 2 without evidence of transformation.
document_terms.date_evidence:

Repeat biopsy showed follicular lymphoma grade 3A without evidence of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma transformation.
